answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. What survives to the comet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the ridge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the horizon of the next round.
